summary: DEEP GREEN HOLDING AS (org. no. 915 215 955) is a private limited company (AS) based in Oslo, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2015-04-09. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 68.320 (Eiendomsforvaltning på oppdrag); it has 0 registered employees. In its 2025 accounts (company level) operating revenue was NOK 0 and net income was -NOK 69 356. CEO: Remy Michel Joel Dutour; board chair: Remy Michel Joel Dutour. Also: LEI 549300INMTK1SNGL4S97.
